header: One feature, with the image on either side
bodytext:
Rich text on one side, a screenshot or photo on the other, and a switch that swaps them. Stack several rows and swap every second one to build a product tour.

Up to four short points sit under the text as bullets, and one button ends the row.
caption: The image keeps its proportions at every screen width.

points.title: Reverse
points.text: Swaps the two columns. The order in the HTML stays the same.

points.title: Featured
points.text: Puts one row on its own surface, so it stands out from the others.

points.title: Rich text
points.text: The main text uses the rich text editor, not a plain text field.

image.alternative: Copper pipes and brass valves mounted on a concrete wall.
